title: Publish runbook follow-ups from the WCLI-130 review (step 6 one-line pattern, Latest read-back, rollback wording)
description: Not a flip gate; matters for later releases. LOWs of the Opus APPROVE of opum-ai/ward-cli#242 (merged): (1) install runbook rollback: drop ", or revoke the approvals before downgrading", because revoking is unmeasured as sufficient (WCLI-130 item 3 asked for it); (6) publish runbook step 6: put the grep -qxF pattern on ONE line in the raw file, because a wrapped code span copied raw embeds a newline and breaks idempotency, and append the superseded line with a blank line first; (2) add a Latest read-back after step 6 (the Latest release is v0.1.1); (3) reword the flip gate text after the first public release; (7) pin the whole command gh release edit v0.1.0 --notes-file old.md --latest=false in the test rather than its parts.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The rollback text no longer offers revoking approvals before downgrading
Step 6 has the grep pattern on one raw line, appends with a blank line first, and reads back that v0.1.1 is Latest
A test pins the whole gh release edit v0.1.0 command
